authority: CEO Round 125 P0 directive: 'make promotion machine-enforced. The engine must refuse WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR unless every required gate is green.'
status: SPECIFICATION. The 17 gates are defined. They are NOT yet wired into the portfolio controller.

governance_compliance.article_I: Each gate has explicit evidence requirements before GREEN is granted.
governance_compliance.article_IV: No fallback — a RED gate cannot be bypassed by aggregating other GREEN gates.
governance_compliance.article_V: Fail closed but do not become a universal rejector — every gate has a NOT_APPLICABLE handling where physically justified.
governance_compliance.article_VII: A RED gate is corrected by adding evidence or correcting the claim — never by weakening the gate definition.
governance_compliance.article_VIII: Each gate's GREEN status has an adversarial test (what would make this gate GREEN while the underlying system is wrong?).
governance_compliance.article_XIV: RED = STOP. A single RED gate blocks promotion regardless of how many other gates are GREEN.
governance_compliance.article_XV: Disclosure of every gate state transition.
governance_compliance.article_XVII: Each gate has an attempted bypass documented.
governance_compliance.article_XXV: UNRESOLVED gate state cannot be aggregated as GREEN or RED. It blocks promotion.
governance_compliance.article_XXVI: Locally verified ≠ CI-certified. A gate verified by a local run is NOT a CI-certified gate.
governance_compliance.article_XXVII: Every gate threshold has explicit class and provenance.
governance_compliance.article_XXVIII: Passing a gate grants credit ONLY at that gate. No silent promotion across gates.
governance_compliance.article_XXIX: Implementation failure (simulator misconfigured) is separated from mechanism failure (gate exposes mechanism impossibility).
governance_compliance.article_XXX: Before declaring any gate GREEN, ask 'what would make this gate pass while the underlying system is still wrong?'
governance_compliance.article_XXXII: Each gate has its strongest alternative explanation documented.
governance_compliance.article_XXXIII: No irreversible promotion on unresolved gate state.
governance_compliance.machine_enforcement: The engine MUST refuse WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR unless all 17 gates are GREEN or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION.

gate_states.GREEN: Gate passed. Evidence supports the candidate at this gate.
gate_states.YELLOW: Gate partially passed or evidence is unresolved. Cannot promote but can continue investigating.
gate_states.RED: Gate failed. Candidate is BLOCKED at this gate. KILL or fix.
gate_states.UNRESOLVED: Gate has not been evaluated or evidence is insufficient. Cannot promote.
gate_states.NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION: Gate is not relevant to this candidate. Requires evidence-grounded justification per APPLICABLE_WORLD_SET_REGISTRY.

gates.definition: The failure mode the candidate addresses is documented in clinical evidence, post-market surveillance, or observed buyer pain — NOT hypothetical or inferred from analogy.
evidence_required: Clinical literature citation with exact passage
OR post-market surveillance data (MAUDE with FDA limitations carried)
OR direct buyer pain documentation
NOT analogy to a different patient population or device
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: Failure mode documented in the candidate's specific patient population and device context.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Failure mode plausibly exists but not yet documented in the candidate's specific context (e.g., eShunt obstruction not yet observed in STRIDE 5-year data).
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Failure mode does not exist or is already adequately addressed by existing solutions.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while the problem doesn't actually exist? Answer: citing a different patient population's failure mode as if it applied to the candidate's population. Mitigation: require population-specific evidence.
gates.article_XXXII_alternative: Alternative: the problem exists but is already solved by an existing solution the candidate doesn't beat. Test: identify the best existing solution and prove the candidate is not unnecessary.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires a population-specific evidence citation. No citation, no GREEN.

gates.definition: Candidate survives §102 (novelty) and §103 (obviousness) patent gate with exact claim language, not abstract similarity.
evidence_required: §102: passage-level comparison against top-K most-relevant prior-art references. No single reference discloses all limitations.
§103: motivation-to-combine analysis with explicit reasoning for why a POSITA would not combine references.
Search completeness certificate: SEARCH_COMPLETE OR explicit declaration of which databases were inaccessible
Patent counsel opinion (recommended for high-stakes candidates)
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: §102 SURVIVES + §103 UNCERTAIN (motivation present but not in prior art).
gates.acceptance_for_RED: §102 destroyed (single reference discloses all limitations) OR §103 destroyed (clear motivation to combine).
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while the candidate is anticipated? Answer: the search missed a key reference. Mitigation: multi-source search (PatSnap, Google Patents, PatentBear, Patent Office search) with explicit completeness declaration.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires multi-source search with completeness certificate. Single-source search cannot be GREEN.

gates.definition: Candidate does not violate any Cemetery Entry (CE) constraint.
evidence_required: Cemetery consultation: every CE entry checked against the candidate mechanism
If candidate matches a CE pattern, justification for why the CE does not apply
For PROVEN_INVARIANT CEs (CE-001, CE-003): HARD BLOCK. Candidate cannot proceed unless it uses a fundamentally different mechanism.
For FAILURE_LESSON / STRONG_CONSTRAINT CEs: candidate must demonstrate it does not repeat the failure
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: No CE violations. All relevant CEs consulted.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Candidate resembles a FAILURE_LESSON CE but may use a different mechanism. Requires explicit A/B test.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while the candidate is impossible? Answer: the candidate is subtly violating a CE under a different name. Mitigation: mechanical pattern matching against CE failure modes, not just label matching.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires CE consultation record. PROVEN_INVARIANT violation = automatic RED.

gates.definition: If the candidate relies on parameter estimation from measurements, the parameters are mathematically identifiable (both structural and numerical) under realistic noise.
evidence_required: Structural identifiability: Jacobian rank analysis showing all parameters are recoverable
Numerical identifiability: condition number < 1e4 AND parameter correlations < 0.95 under realistic noise (per CE-001 lesson)
If identifiability does not apply (e.g., the candidate has no parameter estimation): mark NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: Structural + numerical identifiability confirmed, OR NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Numerical non-identifiability under realistic noise (CE-001 pattern).
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Structural identifiability passes but numerical identifiability is borderline.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while the candidate is non-identifiable? Answer: noise model is too optimistic. Mitigation: require realistic noise from sensor datasheets (per AI Loop V3 noise-model requirement).
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires condition number + correlation evidence OR NOT_APPLICABLE justification.
gates.applies_to_all_candidates: conditional — NOT_APPLICABLE if no parameter estimation

gates.definition: Candidate survives World A (FEBio) physics simulation with applicable constitutive models, validated L1-L8.
evidence_required: FEBio L1-L8 certificates current
Candidate-specific simulation: applicable constitutive model, applicable boundary conditions, applicable loading
Result confirms candidate mechanism within pre-registered tolerance
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: World A simulation confirms candidate mechanism.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: World A simulation contradicts candidate mechanism.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: World A simulation is borderline or sensitivity analysis is incomplete.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while World A is wrong? Answer: the FEBio constitutive model is mis-specified. Mitigation: cross-world comparison (G08).
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires FEBio simulation result + L1-L8 currency verification.

gates.definition: Candidate survives World B (Peridgm) physics simulation — independent fracture mathematics.
evidence_required: Peridgm P1-P8 certification (per PERIDIGM_CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_V1.json)
Candidate-specific simulation in Peridgm
If World B is NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD for this candidate (per APPLICABLE_WORLD_SET_REGISTRY): NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: World B simulation confirms candidate mechanism, OR NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: World B simulation contradicts candidate mechanism (after disagreement classification — could be PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT rather than immediate kill).
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Peridgm not yet certified, or disagreement classification incomplete.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while World B is wrong? Answer: Peridgm and FEBio secretly share assumptions (CE-023). Mitigation: P8 independence certification at file level.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires Peridgm P8 certification + candidate simulation OR NOT_APPLICABLE justification.

gates.definition: Candidate survives World C (clotFoam) physics simulation — flow, transport, clot formation.
evidence_required: clotFoam published examples reproduced (verification)
Candidate-specific simulation in clotFoam within clotFoam's validated scope (flow/transport, NOT fracture oracle initially)
If World C is NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD for this candidate: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: World C simulation confirms candidate mechanism, OR NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: World C simulation contradicts candidate mechanism (after disagreement classification).
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: clotFoam not yet certified for the candidate's scope.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while World C is wrong? Answer: clotFoam is being used outside its validated scope (as a fracture oracle). Mitigation: enforce clotFoam's bounded role per Round 124 architecture.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires clotFoam verification + candidate simulation within clotFoam's validated scope OR NOT_APPLICABLE justification.

gates.definition: Where multiple worlds are applicable, they agree on the candidate mechanism — or any disagreement is classified per the 4-stage disagreement classification (PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT → MATHEMATICAL_MODEL_DISAGREEMENT → PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION → HYPOTHESIS_KILLED).
evidence_required: Cross-world comparison benchmark (P7 of Peridgm protocol, equivalent for other worlds)
Disagreement classification (if any) with A/B testing of suspected cause
Independence certification (P8 of Peridgm protocol, equivalent for other worlds)
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: All applicable worlds agree, OR any disagreement is classified as PHYSICS_DISAGREEMENT with explicit A/B test confirming the attribution.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Disagreement classified as PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION or HYPOTHESIS_KILLED.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Disagreement exists but classification is incomplete.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while worlds secretly disagree? Answer: forced agreement by re-parameterizing one world post-hoc. Mitigation: parameters set independently from material characterization, not re-fit.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires cross-world comparison record + independence certification OR NOT_APPLICABLE (single-world candidate).

gates.definition: Candidate's competing hypotheses (H0, H2, H3, H4) are explicitly tested and discriminated.
evidence_required: H0_null: test designed to reject null (candidate mechanism is not just noise)
H2_strongest_alternative: test designed to discriminate candidate from strongest alternative
H3_implementation_artifact: test designed to rule out measurement/numerical artifact
H4_competing_mechanism: test designed to discriminate candidate from competing mechanism
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: All 4 competing hypotheses tested and discriminated in candidate's favor.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Any competing hypothesis test favors the alternative.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Some hypotheses tested but not all 4.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while a competing hypothesis is true? Answer: the H2 test was too weak. Mitigation: pre-register H2 test BEFORE running it; require H2 to be the STRONGEST alternative, not a strawman.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires 4 explicit hypothesis tests with pre-registered acceptance criteria.

gates.definition: Candidate survives parameter sweep across the validity domain, with adversarial sampling near expected failure boundary.
evidence_required: Parameter space explicitly bounded (per CE-032 — validity domain must be explicit)
Latin Hypercube Sampling + adversarial sampling near failure boundary
Sweep coverage: ≥80% of validity domain tested
No false positives in negative controls (parameter combinations where mechanism should NOT work)
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: Sweep complete, ≥80% coverage, no failures in validity domain, no false positives.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Sweep reveals parameter regions where candidate fails within validity domain.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while the sweep was insufficient? Answer: validity domain was narrowed to exclude failure regions post-hoc. Mitigation: validity domain pre-registered BEFORE sweep.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires pre-registered validity domain + sweep coverage record + negative control results.

gates.definition: Candidate survives geometry variations: holes, defects, asymmetry, heterogeneous regions.
evidence_required: Geometry variations tested (at minimum: idealized, asymmetric, with defects, with heterogeneity)
If patient-specific geometry is applicable (World D): patient-specific variations tested
No geometry-induced failure modes within the validity domain
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: All geometry variations tested; no failures.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Some variations tested but not all 4 categories.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while geometry is a hidden failure mode? Answer: only idealized geometry tested. Mitigation: require all 4 geometry categories (idealized, asymmetric, defects, heterogeneity).

gates.definition: Candidate mechanism is detectable by realistic sensors with realistic noise, sampling rate, latency, drift, quantization.
evidence_required: Virtual instrument with noise sourced from REAL sensor datasheets (per AI Loop V3 noise-model requirement)
Noise model includes: 1/f drift, quantization, EMI spectrum, response time, hysteresis (where applicable)
Candidate signal still detectable above noise floor
No false positives in negative controls under noise
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: Signal detectable above realistic noise; no false positives.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Signal buried in noise OR high false-positive rate.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Pure Gaussian noise tested; datasheet-sourced noise not yet tested.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while real sensors would fail? Answer: noise model is too clean (pure Gaussian). Mitigation: require datasheet-sourced noise model.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires datasheet-sourced noise model + signal-to-noise evidence + false-positive evidence.
gates.applies_to_candidates_with_sensor_output: NOT_APPLICABLE if candidate has no sensor output (e.g., a passive valve with no instrumentation)

gates.definition: Candidate survives variation of model form: constitutive law, solver, discretization, fracture model, timestep, mesh.
evidence_required: Multiple model forms tested (e.g., neo-Hookean vs. Mooney-Rivlin; FEM vs. meshfree)
Multiple solver settings tested (implicit vs. explicit; different timesteps)
Multiple mesh/discretization densities tested
Result robust across model forms OR disagreement classified per G08
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Result sensitive to model form (after disagreement classification).
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Some model forms tested but not all relevant ones.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while model form is a hidden failure? Answer: all model forms share a hidden assumption (circular validation). Mitigation: cross-world test (G08) with independent code bases.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires multiple-model-form test record + cross-world verification.

gates.definition: Candidate's decision-value test passes — buyer would pay for this candidate, OR clinical outcome is materially improved.
evidence_required: Pre-registered buyer threshold (e.g., ≥50% reduction in failure mode)
Simulation/experiment confirms candidate meets threshold
Buyer sentiment: NOT_ASSESSED OR WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES OR WOULD_PAY
If BUYER_SENTIMENT is NOT_ASSESSED: candidate cannot be GREEN; YELLOW maximum
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: Pre-registered threshold met + buyer sentiment assessed.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Threshold missed OR buyer sentiment is WOULD_NOT_PAY.
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Threshold met but buyer sentiment not assessed.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while buyer wouldn't actually pay? Answer: threshold was post-hoc lowered. Mitigation: pre-registered threshold BEFORE simulation/experiment.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires pre-registered threshold + buyer sentiment assessment.

gates.definition: Where published experimental data exists for the candidate's domain, the simulator stack reproduces it.
evidence_required: Identify published experimental data relevant to candidate's mechanism
Reproduce published result within pre-registered tolerance (per VLB-001 pattern)
If no published data exists: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Published data not reproduced (simulator stack inadequate for this domain).
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Reproduction attempted but tolerance not met.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while reproduction is fake? Answer: parameters re-fit to match. Mitigation: parameter custody per VLB-001 spec.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires reproduction record with parameter custody OR NOT_APPLICABLE justification.

gates.definition: Claim-Evidence Graph for this candidate is GREEN for all virtual-supported claims, with explicit reality gap for physical claims.
evidence_required: Claim-Evidence Graph populated for this candidate (per CLAIM_EVIDENCE_GRAPH_V1.json pattern)
All virtual-supported claims at GREEN or YELLOW
All physical-supported claims explicitly marked RED (reality gap) until physical experiment confirms
No unresolved evidence silently aggregated
gates.acceptance_for_GREEN: All virtual claims GREEN; physical claims explicitly RED with reality gap documented.
gates.acceptance_for_RED: Any virtual claim at RED (virtual campaign failed).
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while claims are unsupported? Answer: claims were silently promoted from YELLOW to GREEN without new evidence. Mitigation: per Article XXVIII, promotion requires NEW evidence.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires per-claim state vector + reality gap documentation.

gates.definition: Candidate has a complete, frozen virtual dossier summarizing all gates, evidence, and remaining gaps.
evidence_required: Dossier document with: candidate mechanism, all gate states, evidence ledger, Claim-Evidence Graph, competing hypotheses, load-bearing assumptions, parameter space, geometry, instrument noise, model-form, decision-value, published reproduction, reality gap
Dossier frozen (hash recorded) — no further virtual changes affect promotion
Dossier reviewed by independent agent (not the agent who built it)
gates.acceptance_for_YELLOW: Dossier complete but not yet independently reviewed.
gates.adversarial_test: What would make this gate GREEN while dossier is misleading? Answer: reviewer is the same agent who built it. Mitigation: require independent reviewer + hash freeze.
gates.machine_enforcement: GREEN requires frozen dossier hash + independent reviewer signature.

machine_enforcement_protocol.promotion_check: When candidate is proposed for WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR promotion, the engine iterates all 17 gates. For each gate: state must be GREEN or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION. Any RED, YELLOW, or UNRESOLVED gate blocks promotion.
machine_enforcement_protocol.evidence_custody: Every GREEN gate has an evidence pointer (artifact + commit hash). Every NOT_APPLICABLE gate has a justification pointer (APPLICABLE_WORLD_SET_REGISTRY entry).
machine_enforcement_protocol.audit_log: Every gate state transition is recorded with: previous state, new state, evidence pointer, agent who triggered transition, timestamp.
machine_enforcement_protocol.no_self_certification: The agent who ran the virtual campaign cannot be the agent who certifies the gates. Independent verification required.
machine_enforcement_protocol.anti_gaming: If a candidate has >2 NOT_APPLICABLE gates, audit the classifications per APPLICABLE_WORLD_SET_REGISTRY anti-bureaucracy principle.

honest_status: SPECIFICATION ONLY. The 17 gates are defined. They are NOT yet implemented as machine-enforced checks. No candidate has been evaluated against all 17 gates.
